def render_g_cost_by_carrier(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Access the primary dataset (shipment_quality.csv)
    df = dataframes.get('shipment_quality.csv')
    if df is None or df.empty:
        # Draw a placeholder empty box if data is missing
        pdf.set_fill_color(240, 240, 240)
        pdf.rect(x, y, w, h, style='F')
        pdf.set_xy(x, y + h/2 - 5)
        pdf.set_font("Arial", "I", 10)
        pdf.cell(w, 10, "Dados indisponíveis", border=0, align='C')
        return

    # Check required columns
    if 'carrier' not in df.columns or 'cost' not in df.columns:
        return

    # Aggregate total cost per carrier
    cost_by_carrier = df.groupby('carrier')['cost'].sum().sort_values(ascending=False)
    carriers = cost_by_carrier.index.tolist()
    costs = cost_by_carrier.values

    # Limit categories if too many (>15) – not needed here, but safe
    if len(carriers) > 15:
        threshold = costs[-1]  # just an example: keep top ones
        mask = costs >= threshold
        others_sum = costs[~mask].sum()
        carriers = carriers[mask].tolist() + ['Outros']
        costs = costs[mask].tolist() + [others_sum]

    # Matplotlib figure size from given dimensions (mm -> inches)
    fig_width = w / 25.4
    fig_height = h / 25.4
    plt.figure(figsize=(fig_width, fig_height))

    # Bar chart
    colors = plt.cm.Set2.colors[:len(carriers)]  # up to ~8 distinct colors, else default
    bars = plt.bar(carriers, costs, color=colors, edgecolor='white', linewidth=0.8)

    # Title and labels
    plt.title("Custo por Transportadora", fontsize=min(12, fig_height*2.5), fontweight='bold')
    plt.xlabel("Transportadora", fontsize=min(10, fig_height*2))
    plt.ylabel("Custo Total (R$)", fontsize=min(10, fig_height*2))
    plt.xticks(rotation=0, ha='center', fontsize=min(9, fig_height*1.8))
    plt.yticks(fontsize=min(8, fig_height*1.6))

    # Format y-axis ticks with comma separator
    plt.gca().yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda x, p: f'{x:,.0f}'))

    # Annotate bars with values
    for bar, val in zip(bars, costs):
        height = bar.get_height()
        plt.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height,
                 f'R${val:,.0f}',
                 ha='center', va='bottom',
                 fontsize=min(8, fig_height*1.5), fontweight='bold')

    # Remove top/right spines for cleaner look
    plt.gca().spines['top'].set_visible(False)
    plt.gca().spines['right'].set_visible(False)

    # Adjust layout to fit within figure
    plt.tight_layout(pad=0.2)

    # Save to temporary PNG and insert into PDF
    import tempfile, os
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close()
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

def render_g_late_trend_by_warehouse(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Get the primary dataframe
    df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
    
    # Validate required columns
    required_cols = ['week', 'warehouse', 'late_pct']
    for col in required_cols:
        if col not in df.columns:
            return  # silently skip if columns missing
    
    # Convert week to string and sort weeks naturally
    df = df.copy()
    df['week'] = df['week'].astype(str)
    
    # Pivot: rows = week, columns = warehouse, values = late_pct
    pivot = df.pivot_table(index='week', columns='warehouse', values='late_pct', aggfunc='mean')
    
    # Sort weeks chronologically (assumes format like YYYY-W##)
    try:
        pivot = pivot.reindex(sorted(pivot.index, key=lambda w: (int(w.split('-')[0]), int(w.split('-')[1].replace('W','')))))
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    # Create matplotlib figure with exact dimensions in mm -> inches
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w/25.4, h/25.4))
    
    # Plot each warehouse as a line
    for warehouse in pivot.columns:
        ax.plot(pivot.index, pivot[warehouse], marker='o', label=warehouse, linewidth=2)
    
    # Labels and title in Portuguese
    ax.set_xlabel('Semana', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel('Percentual de Atraso (%)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Evolução do Atraso por Armazém', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
    
    # Format y-axis with percentage sign
    ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(plt.FuncFormatter(lambda val, _: f'{val:.1f}%'))
    
    # Rotate x-axis labels for readability
    plt.setp(ax.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=8)
    
    # Legend
    ax.legend(title='Armazém', fontsize=8, title_fontsize=9)
    
    # Tight layout to avoid clipping
    plt.tight_layout()
    
    # Save to temporary PNG and insert into PDF
    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.png', delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
        plt.close(fig)
        pdf.image(tmp.name, x=x, y=y, w=w, h=h)
        os.unlink(tmp.name)

    if df is None or df.empty:

import os
os.environ.setdefault('MPLCONFIGDIR', '/tmp/matplotlib')
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from fpdf import FPDF, XPos, YPos
import tempfile
import textwrap

sns.set_theme(style='whitegrid')

def _safe_pdf_text(value):
    replacements = {
        '\u2013': '-', '\u2014': '-', '\u2015': '-',
        '\u2018': "'", '\u2019': "'", '\u201c': '"', '\u201d': '"',
        '\u2022': '-', '\u00a0': ' ', '\u2026': '...'
    }
    text = str(value or '')
    for source, target in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(source, target)
    return text.encode('latin-1', 'replace').decode('latin-1')

def _wrap_lines(text, max_chars):
    lines = []
    for paragraph in str(text).splitlines() or ['']:
        wrapped = textwrap.wrap(paragraph.strip(), width=max_chars) or ['']
        lines.extend(wrapped)
    return lines

def _sentence_chunks(text):
    normalized = ' '.join(str(text).split())
    chunks, current = [], []
    for token in normalized.split(' '):
        current.append(token)
        if token.rstrip().endswith(('.', '!', '?', ';')):
            chunks.append(' '.join(current))
            current = []
    if current:
        chunks.append(' '.join(current))
    return chunks or [normalized]

def _fit_text_to_box(text, w, h, font_size, line_height):
    max_chars = max(14, int(w * 0.55 * (10 / max(font_size, 1))))
    max_lines = max(1, int(h / max(line_height, 1)))
    if len(_wrap_lines(text, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
        return text
    selected = []
    for sentence in _sentence_chunks(text):
        candidate = ' '.join(selected + [sentence]).strip()
        if not candidate:
            continue
        if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) <= max_lines:
            selected.append(sentence)
        elif selected:
            break
        else:
            words = sentence.split()
            compact = []
            for word in words:
                candidate = ' '.join(compact + [word])
                if len(_wrap_lines(candidate, max_chars)) > max_lines:
                    break
                compact.append(word)
            selected.append(' '.join(compact))
            break
    fitted = ' '.join(selected).strip()
    return fitted

def _write_report_title(pdf, title, font_family):
    clean_title = ' '.join(_safe_pdf_text(title or 'Relatório Analítico').split())
    for size in range(16, 10, -1):
        max_chars = max(28, int(58 * (16 / size)))
        lines = textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=max_chars) or [clean_title]
        if len(lines) <= 2:
            pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', size)
            pdf.multi_cell(0, 8, '\n'.join(lines), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')
            return
    pdf.set_font(font_family, 'B', 11)
    pdf.multi_cell(0, 7, '\n'.join(textwrap.wrap(clean_title, width=84)), new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT, align='C')

def render_text_block(pdf, text, x, y, w, h, title=None):
    font_size = 10
    line_height = 5
    text = _safe_pdf_text(text)
    title = _safe_pdf_text(title) if title else None
    body_height = h
    pdf.set_xy(x, y)
    if title:
        pdf.set_font('helvetica', 'B', font_size)
        pdf.cell(w, 7, title, new_x=XPos.LMARGIN, new_y=YPos.NEXT)
        body_height = max(1, h - 8)
        pdf.set_xy(x, pdf.get_y())
    
    fitted_text = _fit_text_to_box(text, w, body_height, font_size, line_height)
    pdf.set_font('helvetica', '', font_size)
    pdf.multi_cell(w, line_height, fitted_text, align='J')

def render_g_damage_vs_cost(pdf, dataframes, x, y, w, h):
    # Get the primary DataFrame (shipment_quality.csv)
    df = list(dataframes.values())[0]
    if df is None or df.empty:
        return

    # Ensure required columns exist
    x_col = 'damage_pct'
    y_col = 'cost'
    hue_col = 'carrier'
    if not all(col in df.columns for col in [x_col, y_col, hue_col]):
        return

    # Create figure with correct aspect ratio
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(w / 25.4, h / 25.4))
    sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

    # Scatter plot colored by carrier
    sns.scatterplot(data=df, x=x_col, y=y_col, hue=hue_col,
                    ax=ax, s=80, palette='Set2')

    # Add overall trend line
    if len(df) > 1:
        coeffs = np.polyfit(df[x_col], df[y_col], 1)
        poly = np.poly1d(coeffs)
        x_range = np.linspace(df[x_col].min(), df[x_col].max(), 100)
        ax.plot(x_range, poly(x_range), color='gray',
                linestyle='--', linewidth=1, label='Tendência geral')

    # Labels and title (Portuguese)
    ax.set_xlabel('Percentual de Danos (%)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel('Custo (R$)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Dano vs Custo por Transportadora', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    ax.tick_params(labelsize=8)
    ax.legend(title='Transportadora', fontsize=7, title_fontsize=8)

    plt.tight_layout()

    with tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix=".png", delete=False) as tmp:
        plt.savefig(tmp.name, dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight', pad_inches=0.05)
